source_snapshot.test_name_items: Check switch function about Clear CMOS
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check switch function about Clear CMOS
1.Make Switch to another side.
2. Power on system , negative to jumper function page check.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Switch to another side , systerm still can power onsuccessfully.
2. Switch need functionaly.
3. Switch to orginal side , system should not hang or create error log.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- not runnable by agent: this switch-function check for Clear CMOS (via the Clear-CMOS path) requires physically moving the Clear-CMOS jumper to the other side, powering on to the jumper-function page in BIOS to confirm the feature engages, then returning the switch and confirming the system powers on with no hang/error. Toggling the onboard jumper and reading the BIOS Clear-CMOS path page is physical/Pre-OS work only a person at the machine can do.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: operator toggles the Clear-CMOS jumper (Clear-CMOS path), powers on, reads the BIOS jumper page, restores the switch, and confirms a clean power-on with no error log; agent cannot operate the motherboard jumper.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: physical/hardware operation at the machine - human only; agent must not attempt.

historical_reviews.deepseek: NO. Correctly identifies the physical clear-CMOS path and restoration, but does not define which settings must reset.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY / IMPROVED. V2 adds board identity, an explicit reset matrix, configuration backup and recovery evidence.
historical_reviews.v3: No V3 Pilot record exists for this source key.
historical_reviews.v3_1: No V3.1 200-case record exists for this source key.

original_test_intent: Verify the physical Clear-CMOS switch selects the intended firmware clear behavior, then returns to normal operation after the switch is restored, without hang or unexpected error.
original_method: A qualified operator records BIOS settings/time/security state, de-energizes and moves the identified Clear-CMOS switch, powers on and observes the approved clear page/effects, powers down, restores the original side, reboots and verifies the reset matrix and recovered configuration.
manual_activity: Physical switch movement/restoration and direct BIOS/POST observation are the core test; remote status cannot prove them or the exact reset behavior.
required_inputs: Exact board and Clear-CMOS switch reference/orientations
Authoritative reset matrix for date/time, selected settings, passwords and boot/security state
Power discharge/ESD, boot timeout and console/OOB recovery
Final state, operator and one-user approval
safety_requirements: Never move the switch while powered and stop on uncertain identity or orientation.
Protect settings, passwords, boot keys and recovery data before clearing CMOS.
Stop on no boot, unexpected security reset, hang, OOB loss or inability to restore original side.
Preserve the first outcome and do not automatically retry or silently restore settings.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only board/BIOS/BMC identity, settings exposed safely, console, SEL and host-health evidence.
Maintain the before/after reset matrix and correlate operator position/power timestamps.
Do not move hardware, enter secrets or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve switch mapping, reset matrix and recovery.
Perform all physical actions and BIOS observations.
Restore approved configuration and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its no-command/manual boundary is appropriate, but successful boot plus a page is not sufficient evidence of Clear-CMOS function.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the physical/Pre-OS sequence and use read-only configuration/log collection only as corroboration.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Alternate side, function-page check, original-side restoration, no-hang/no-error and 10/20-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: RETAIN PHYSICAL CLEAR-CMOS SWITCH TEST WITH RESET MATRIX
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use switch-position photos, console capture and an owner-approved before/after matrix for time, settings, credentials and boot state, followed by verified restoration.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact motherboard and BIOS Clear-CMOS implementation.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board, BIOS, BMC and CPLD revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner board Clear-CMOS switch and BIOS reset/recovery specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds actual reset-effect proof instead of relying on successful boot.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No loss; the physical path and clean restored boot remain required.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Mapping, reset semantics, backups and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Firmware may intentionally retain some protected values, so the reset matrix must be authoritative.

project_override_considerations: A project may choose the settings used to prove reset, but must identify them before execution and cannot replace the physical switch with a software defaults command without an explicit coverage change.
expected_evidence: Board/BIOS/switch identity, reset matrix, backups/recovery and authorization
Original/alternate switch records and power/console timestamps
Clear-CMOS page plus before/after date/time/settings/password/boot evidence
Original-side restoration, approved final configuration, clean boot/no errors and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The wording is vague but does not contain opposing instructions; exact reset effects are missing acceptance inputs that the owner must define.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The owner can supply the reset matrix and a qualified operator can execute the coherent physical sequence.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agree with NO but expand proof beyond the BIOS page and boot.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agree with MANUAL ONLY and reset-matrix safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates physical execution, supporting agent evidence and formal engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Requires measurable CMOS effects and safe configuration recovery rather than accepting a generic functional page as proof.
independent_technical_reasoning: A Clear-CMOS switch changes a physical motherboard path and its effects appear before the OS. Both actuation and primary observation require an operator, making the case MANUAL ONLY despite automatable supporting logs.
